title: Dev9 accepted test checkpoint — occurrence-level temporal provenance
summary: Dev9 introduces append-only source-edition/occurrence/span-anchored provenance with separate publication and observation cutoffs, correction and retraction histories, multiple lineage parents, insertion-order-independent canonical projections, cycle detection and fail-closed forked evidence. Native ooRexx 5.3.0 r13196 qualification executed 115 checks (102 positives plus 13 expected-negative cases) on the delivered archive. This is an experimental tested checkpoint, not a production authority or proven source independence.
invariants: Use declared evidence links only; never promote alleged corroboration into demonstrated source dependency or independent verification.
CORRECT and RETRACT preserve original historical knowledge through two cutoffs; retraction is not proof of falsity.
Conflicting branch tips are unknown rather than a first-writer/last-writer stance; cycle returns unresolved.
No editorial-bias, omission, social influence, causal Brand Effect, CMS publishing or HardWorld decision authority.
Source span reference is an identifier, not cryptographically verified quote bytes or an authenticated media capture.
Time conversion is from Single Time Service v0.3 pinned qualification; upstream v0.9 exists but has not been adopted or requalified.
